test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Hobson's choice
solution:
The correct answer is, '**A choice forced upon someone**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It's also known as giving a free choice when there is no actual alternative.
 
 
• For example, ***the boss gave him Hobson's choice, 'Work hard or get fired.***'
 
 
 
• Hobson was a man who used to rent his horses, but apparently, people overworked those horses. So Hobson came up with some strict rules and choices, that made this idiom. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
